notes: City of Providence, RI. Rhode Island has no county government, so the city is the assessing and taxing unit and the city's own parcel layer is already city-only (no clip).

~37.6k shipped parcels from PVDGIS AGOL (services6.arcgis.com/wv9mHoqblhTsnqdG) Parcel_Zoning_FL/FeatureServer/0 'Parcels with CAMA', TaxRollYear 2025 = ASSESSED 2024-12-31 (revaluation/statistical update), BILLED FY2026. Vintage verified from billed taxes: the roll's implied rates are exactly the FY2026 ordinance rates (8.40 / 7.55 / 14.60 / 14.00 / 26.00 / 28.50 residential, 29.20 commercial; RI DMF 'FY 2026 Tax Rates by Class of Property, Assessment Date December 31, 2024'). The Socrata description of the '2025' roll says 'billed in FY2025' — that is off by one; FY2025 bills (assessed 12/31/2023) are the '2024' roll at 18.35 / 35.10. See run_providence.py. ~38k parcels -> browser GeoParquet path, no PMTiles/H3 (Lynchburg/Newport News size class).

Do NOT source from the same org's Parcels_with_CAMA (edited 2025-05), Parcel_Boundaries_v1 (2024-09) or Parcels_wCAMA (2024-09) layers: identical schema, but TaxRollYear 2024/2024/2023 = assessed 12/31/2023 (FY2025 bills, pre-revaluation) and 12/31/2022 — ~30% lower totals; sample parcels match the older Socrata rolls exactly. run_providence.py hard-fails if the layer's TaxRollYear is not 2025.

Exemption comes from the city's Socrata '2025 Property Tax Roll' (6ub4-iebe; same assessed-12/31/2024 roll), joined on PROPID: levy code E01 = fully exempt, dropped per record before the condo collapse. 8LAW (RIGL 44-5-13.11) and TSA (RIGL 44-3-9 stabilization) records are abatements on fully assessed property and are kept taxable. Utility (use 10) dropped.

CONDO LAND IS $0 IN THE SOURCE: every condo unit (use 23/24, 4.1k units) carries AssessedValueLand = 0 with the whole unit value in AssessedValueBuildings; the assessor does not split condo land. Units are mapped as N identical copies of the lot polygon (max stack 503), so they collapse to one parcel per lot (values summed across distinct units). The ~660 merged condo lots (~179 acres, ~$1.8B total value) keep the assessor's $0 land and appear in the gp-error layer. Not imputed.
169 PROPIDs appear 2-3x with identical geometry and values in the source; deduped with values `first` (never summed).

Providence's roll has NO parking use code (surface lots sit in Vacant Land 13/14 or Commercial II 06), so the Underused tab's 'Parking Lot' bucket is empty and the Parking tab is the only parking source. Parking is OSM-only (classified: 462 surface / 31 structure / 6 excluded / 2 uncertain; 13 surface lots dropped by the parcel-context filter). OSM-only undercounts; treat it as a floor.
link is the Tax Assessor landing page, not a per-parcel deep link.
